data.one_liner: A Flutter package providing 7000+ solar-themed icons in multiple styles.
data.what_it_does: The package supplies a large collection of solar‑style icons as Dart constants. Icons are bundled in a single tree‑shakeable font, making them easy to import and use in Flutter widgets.
use_when: You need a wide variety of ready‑made icons without external assets
You want a single, tree‑shakeable font for many icon styles
avoid_when: You require icons from a different design language or custom SVG assets
strengths: Simple API using standard Icon widget
weaknesses: Limited to the solar icon set
No theming or dynamic icon generation

alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a well‑known, extensive icon set with many community examples
